steps.title: slugify lowercases and joins words with dashes
steps.description:
Create function slugify(text: str) -> str in slugify/core.py (package: slugify).
Lowercase the text, replace each run of non-alphanumeric characters with a
single "-", and strip leading/trailing "-".
Examples: "Hello, World!" -> "hello-world"; "  A  B " -> "a-b"; "" -> "".
Tests must import it with: from slugify.core import slugify

steps.title: is_slug validates a slug
steps.description:
Create function is_slug(text: str) -> bool in slugify/validate.py.
True only for non-empty text made of lowercase letters, digits and single
dashes, not starting or ending with a dash.
Examples: "hello-world" -> True; "Hello" -> False; "a--b" -> False; "-a" -> False; "" -> False.
Tests must import it with: from slugify.validate import is_slug

steps.title: truncate_slug cuts at a dash
steps.description:
Create function truncate_slug(slug: str, max_length: int) -> str in slugify/truncate.py.
If the slug is longer than max_length, cut it to max_length characters, then
remove a trailing partial word and trailing dashes.
Examples: ("hello-world", 7) -> "hello"; ("hello-world", 11) -> "hello-world"; ("abc", 2) -> "ab".
(If there is no dash to cut at, just cut to max_length.)
Tests must import it with: from slugify.truncate import truncate_slug
